payload.comment: Ingestion stage evidence is internally consistent and complete. Key checks: (1) Archive integrity confirmed — archive_md5 (a8b06965200029087d5bd730944a56c1) matches verified_archive_md5. (2) Split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match official_split_sizes exactly; subsampled=false. (3) 3-channel RGB, 9-class multi-class task consistent with the standard 28×28 RGB MedMNIST distribution. (4) Selected index SHA-256 hashes are recorded for all three splits, enabling reproducibility. (5) Run manifest records deterministic_torch=true, seed=42, code SHA-256, and full package versions (torch 2.14.0+cu126, lightning 2.6.5, medmnist 3.0.2). (6) The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is properly flagged for OOD awareness. (7) No deterministic findings were raised. Minor observations (non-blocking): worker isolation is not enforced (local_subprocess) and image_digest is null, both of which are acceptable at the ingestion stage and do not indicate a defect. No compacted fields or omitted artefacts. Proceed to the next stage.
